notes: Nylon cable ties, 4 to 14 in, modelled (no CAD is published): fifteen ties of six lengths laid parallel and bound at the middle by a 14 in tie of their own, plus three loose ones (a curled 8 in, a curled 12 in, a 4 in closed into a ring). Each strap is 1.1 mm thick with a saw-tooth ratchet face at 1.6 mm pitch and a moulded head with a through-slot.
